title: Used Insta360 GO 2 inspection
description: Observable pre-payment inspection of a used Insta360 GO 2. Records facts; it does not make the purchase decision.

checks.title: Body and Lens Condition
checks.instruction: Inspect the camera body, lens and visible seals in good light.
checks.help: Look for cracks, deep dents, lens scratches, moisture marks or loose parts.
checks.expected_result: No damage likely to affect normal use or image quality.

checks.title: Power On
checks.help: Confirm it starts without repeated resets or unusual heat.
checks.expected_result: Camera powers on and remains stable.

checks.title: Camera Controls
checks.instruction: Test the physical controls and basic mode changes.
checks.help: Press each available button and confirm the camera responds.

checks.title: Connect to iPhone
checks.instruction: Open the Insta360 app and connect the camera to the iPhone.
checks.help: Use the normal Bluetooth/Wi-Fi pairing flow. Do not enter seller credentials.
checks.expected_result: The camera is discoverable and connects to the app.

checks.title: Activation / Account Status
checks.instruction: Check whether the camera can be used normally with the app without an unexpected account lock or ownership problem.
checks.help: Do not request or record passwords. If ownership status cannot be verified, choose SKIP and note why.
checks.expected_result: No observable account/activation block prevents normal use.

checks.title: Firmware
checks.instruction: Check the firmware status shown by the Insta360 app.
checks.help: Record if the app reports a required update or an error.
checks.expected_result: Firmware is recognized by the app and no blocking error is shown.

checks.title: Video Recording
checks.instruction: Record a short test clip, stop recording, and confirm it saves.
checks.help: Use a normal recording mode and keep the clip short.
checks.expected_result: Recording starts/stops normally and produces a playable file.

checks.title: Video Quality / Lens
checks.instruction: Review the test clip for sharpness, severe blur, spots, flicker or lens artifacts.
checks.help: Move from a bright to a darker area if practical and inspect the image.
checks.expected_result: Image appears consistent with a working camera; no obvious lens defect dominates the frame.

checks.title: Audio
checks.instruction: Record speech and play it back.
checks.help: Listen for missing audio, severe crackling or distortion.
checks.expected_result: Speech is audible without obvious microphone failure.

checks.title: File Transfer
checks.instruction: Transfer or preview the recorded clip on the iPhone through the normal app flow.
checks.help: A successful preview/download is enough; do not transfer private seller media.
checks.expected_result: Recorded media can be accessed from the iPhone.

checks.title: Charging
checks.instruction: Connect the camera/charge case to power and confirm charging begins.
checks.help: Observe the normal charging indicator and check for loose connection behavior.

checks.title: Battery
checks.instruction: Run the camera for several minutes and observe the battery reading for abnormal drop or shutdown.
checks.help: This is only a short field check, not a full battery-capacity test.
checks.expected_result: No immediate shutdown or unusually rapid battery drop is observed.

checks.title: Connection Stability
checks.instruction: Keep the camera connected to the iPhone while navigating the app and previewing media.
checks.help: Note repeated disconnects or reconnection loops.
checks.expected_result: Connection remains usable during the short test.

checks.title: Accessories / Package
checks.instruction: Compare the included accessories with what the seller said is included.
checks.help: Photograph the package if useful. Choose SKIP if no package list was agreed.
checks.expected_result: Observed included items match the seller's stated package.
